title: Software Engineering Intern - Summer 2025
eligibility: Enrolled in a Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science or related STEM field
qualification: Proficiency in C++, C#, Java, or Python, and strong foundational knowledge of data structures and algorithms
description: Microsoft's University Internship program offers students the opportunity to work on scalable real-world projects, receive 1-on-1 mentorship, and accelerate tech careers.

title: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
eligibility: Graduate students, young professionals, and researchers from eligible countries
salary: Fully Funded (Tuition, Monthly Stipend, Airfare, Health Insurance)
qualification: Completed Bachelor's degree, strong academic background, and English language proficiency
description: The Fulbright Foreign Student Program enables graduate students, young professionals, and artists from abroad to study and conduct research in universities in the United States.

title: Junior Frontend Engineer
eligibility: Worldwide applicants with experience in modern JavaScript frameworks
qualification: Experience with Vue.js, JavaScript, HTML/CSS, Git, and RESTful APIs
description: GitLab is hiring remote Frontend Engineers to help build and improve features across the world's largest all-in-one open-source DevOps platform.

title: CS50's Introduction to Computer Science
eligibility: Open to anyone worldwide, no prior coding experience required
description: An entry-level course taught by David J. Malan, covering algorithmic thinking and programming fundamentals using C, Python, SQL, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

title: Google Summer of Code 2025
eligibility: Open source beginners and students aged 18 and older worldwide
salary: Stipend ($1,500 - $3,000 USD based on PPP location)
qualification: Knowledge of programming languages and interest in open-source software development
description: Google Summer of Code is a global program focused on bringing new contributors into open source software organizations through a 12+ week coding project.

title: Associate Product Manager (APM)
eligibility: Recent graduates or early-career professionals with 0-2 years of experience
qualification: Bachelor's degree in CS, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience
description: Google's APM program develops future leaders in tech by placing early-career product managers across cross-functional engineering and product design projects.
